svg.aria-label: Animation: the drafter guesses four tokens, the verifier checks them in one pass, keeps “the capital of” and replaces “Germany” with “France”, so four tokens are added for one pass of the target model
svg.font-family: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
svg.text: 1 · The drafter guesses the next K tokens, one after another
2 · The verifier checks all K guesses in a single pass
3 · Guesses that match are kept; the first miss is replaced
4 · 4 tokens for the cost of 1 target pass. Repeat.
